name: jkrumm-com
comment: Astro 7 needs Node >=22.12; this machine's default is Node 20, so every Astro command is pinned to Bun's runtime (node-compat 24) via `bun --bun <bin>`. Referencing the bin path directly avoids recursing into the `astro` script.

scripts.build: bun --bun node_modules/.bin/astro check && bun --bun node_modules/.bin/astro build
